text: FIX fields listed in `encrypted` have been stored in plain text when the encryption storage is used inside of `wrappedKeyCompressionStorage()` (the order shown in the RxStorage docs) and the schema has `keyCompression: true`. A nested encrypted path made `addCollections()` throw a `TypeError`. The key-compression plugin now also compresses the `encrypted` paths. Documents that have been stored in plain text stay readable with the crypto-js encryption plugin and are encrypted on their next write.
